assets.notes: Authentic smartphone UGC. Women age 42-58 in perimenopause. Use the exact Ember Brain Clarity Protocol pouch from the reference image: matte white stand-up pouch, orange Ember logo, large orange Brain Clarity Protocol text, and a clear gummy window.

promptVars.product: the exact Ember Brain Clarity Protocol supplement pouch shown in the reference image: a matte white resealable stand-up pouch with an orange Ember logo, large orange Brain Clarity Protocol text, small orange supplement text near the bottom, and orange gummies visible through the clear lower window
promptVars.subject: Karen, a 54-year-old former teacher, short silver-blonde hair, soft laugh lines, wearing a cream linen button-down, quiet warm smile
promptVars.scene: her cozy living room in afternoon light, a wooden bookshelf and a small potted plant behind her, warm neutral colors, lived-in and welcoming
promptVars.extra: She holds the Ember pouch at mid-chest with the front label facing the camera. Match the package shape, logo, colors, and front label layout from the reference image closely. Keep the pouch fully readable and do not redesign the package. Natural soft daylight from a window off-frame. No props overlapping the reserved overlay area.
avoid: any jar, bottle, canister, tub, or box packaging
the older red Ember Creatine Gummies pouch design
extra flames, badges, fruit, or marketing callouts printed on the package
changing the Ember logo, the Brain Clarity Protocol title, or the clear gummy window placement

comment.text: My daughter told me I seemed present again at Sunday dinner. I didn't even realize how far gone I was. Four weeks in.
